observations: Sodium Coco-Sulfate leads a glucoside-supported cleanser system.
Three hydrolyzed proteins appear together before the preservative/refatting tail, supporting a deliberate film-forming complex without proving permanent repair.
Glyceryl Oleate, Betaine, PCA Glyceryl Oleate and lipid derivatives provide light conditioning; no silicone is present.
Phytic Acid is a chelation cue, but its position and absent removal test keep clarification low.
